component.name: FFmpeg
component.summary: Convert and inspect audio and video from the command line

description.p: FFmpeg converts, records and streams audio and video. This community package uses FlatPark's ffmpeg-full build, including ffmpeg and ffprobe.

The application menu opens a terminal in your home folder. Run ffmpeg or ffprobe there; type exit to close it. From an existing terminal, use flatpak run org.ffmpeg.FFmpeg for ffmpeg or flatpak run --command=ffprobe org.ffmpeg.FFmpeg for ffprobe.

The sandbox can access your home folder and the network, so relative paths work from any directory in it. External drives are not included: run flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media org.ffmpeg.FFmpeg to add them. Undo overrides with flatpak override --user --reset org.ffmpeg.FFmpeg.
